conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced was found. The main thing the release adds is the full-year forecast decision. Shin-Etsu has held its forecast at each of the last three Q2 prints and the stock fell each time (Oct 2024 -2.9%, Oct 2025 -3.7%), while IFIS consensus OP of 732.2bn sits 4.6% above the company's 700bn. Semiconductor read-throughs (Shin-Etsu Polymer's raise on 10/26) partly offset weak PVC and wafer-industry proxies. That is a small negative lean (p_up 46) on a ~4.5% scale, which gives -0.36. The findings sum to -1.4; that is larger because each proxy is sized on its own, and the scaled number holds the sign uncertainty. The stock is already down 24% from mid-July, so a hold may be priced.
bar: FY3/2027 operating profit: IFIS consensus 732,154m yen (ordinary 799,400m; unchanged over four weeks) against the company forecast of 700,000m (ordinary 770,000m) set 2026-07-24. Sources: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=4063 and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260724598982.pdf. There is no sourced Q2 (Jul-Sep) quarterly consensus, so print_vs_bar is on the full-year guide: an expected hold or a small raise (~705bn) against 732bn is about -3.5%.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0%, no disclosed position >=0.5%, no change (baseline, as of 2026-10-26, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin ratio 信用倍率 18.41x (baseline; kabutan shows 18.41x on 2026-10-27, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4063), so leveraged retail is crowded long, which the baseline already prices as margin_overhang -0.63. There is no skew in Japan. 20d run-up +0.84%, 5d -0.1%, but the stock is ~24% below its 2026-07-15 close of 7,690 yen.

findings.finding: The forecast decision is the main item, and Shin-Etsu's own record says hold. FY3/2024, FY3/2025 and FY3/2026 each kept the Q1-set forecast through the Q2 print; the last Q2 revision was Oct 2022. IFIS consensus OP (732.2bn) is 4.6% above the 700bn guide. The company assumes 160 yen/$ from July; July-September monthly closes were 160.1, 157.4 and 156.9 yen. That gives no FX cushion for a raise, so a hold, read as disappointing against consensus, is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2024 Q2: forecast held, stock -2.9% ('通期業績予想据え置きで物足りなさ', https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4063&b=n202410280562). Oct 2025 Q2: forecast held, -3.67% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4063&b=n202510270297). Jul 2026 first guide 700bn vs ~760bn consensus: -8.3% on 2026-07-27 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4063&b=n202607270833).
findings.source_date: 2026-10-27 (revision history table: FY3/2027 forecast set 26/07/24, dividend-only revision 26/09/15; FY3/2026 set 25/07/24 with no further revision before actual)
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus did not converge to the company guide after July (IFIS ordinary profit 800.9bn four weeks ago, 799.4bn now), so the street still carries ~4.6% above the plan. If the market expected a hold, consensus would have been marked toward 700bn. The offset is that the stock has fallen ~24% since mid-July, and part of a hold is probably in the price, which is why this is sized well under the -2.9/-3.7 precedents.
findings.independence: The FX assumption comes from a separate primary document: Q1 短信 p.22 '2026年7月以降の会社想定レート US$160円程度', https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260724598954.pdf; FX from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X?range=1y&interval=1mo. The consensus figure comes from IFIS (kabuyoho).

findings.finding: A semiconductor-materials read-through from a consolidated subsidiary that reported the day before. On 2026-10-26 Shin-Etsu Polymer (7970) raised its FY ordinary profit from 16.0bn to 18.0bn yen (+12.5%) on strong semiconductor wafer containers, raised its dividend and announced a buyback. R&I upgraded Shin-Etsu to AAA on 2026-10-05, citing AI-driven semiconductor-materials demand. Electronic Materials Q1 OP was +23% YoY (1,019 vs 831 億円).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY3/2027 Electronic Materials +23% OP with the quarter 'ほぼ市場予想線上' still produced -8.3%, because guidance dominated. On this name, segment strength has not lifted the stock at the print when the guide disappointed.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. 4063 is +1.4% at 09:52 JST today, but the Nikkei is +2.1%, so the stock is lagging rather than reacting to the subsidiary. Shin-Etsu Polymer's 2bn ordinary raise is ~0.3% of the parent's 770bn, so its value is as a demand signal for wafers and containers, not as money.
findings.independence: R&I upgrade, separate source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4063&b=n202610060229 (2026-10-06). Q1 segment table: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260724598954.pdf. SUMCO's Q3 guide of sales +4% QoQ (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260806/140120260805509524.pdf) points mildly the same way.

findings.finding: PVC was weak into Q2, and Shintech's April-June results land in this quarter. Overseas subsidiaries are consolidated on a three-month lag (Q1 短信 p.22: '1～3月平均の為替レートは海外子会社の損益を連結する際に使用'). Snippets put US PVC spot at $650/t FAS Houston on 2026-07-15, nearly 40% below early April, with Asia CFR at only $760-840/t in late August. Life Environment segment OP was already -34% YoY in Q1 (348 vs 528 億円).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025 Q2: H1 OP -17.7% on softer PVC from Chinese oversupply, stock -3.67%. Jul 2026: the cautious PVC view was blamed for the guide gap and -8.3%.
findings.source_date: 2026-07-21 (from URL path; snippet_only, page 403 on both WebFetch and curl)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The company knew Shintech's April-June results when it set the 700bn guide on 2026-07-24 and called its PVC view cautious. What could be unpriced is the size of the hit to Q2 segment profit, because the lag shifts it into this print where analysts' quarterly phasing may not. It is sized small because the price series is public and sits inside the guide.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 segment text on the late-May Asia price break, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260724598954.pdf; FISCO on 'シンテックをはじめとした生活環境基盤材料の見方が市場想定より慎重', https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4063&b=n202607270833.

findings.finding: Outside AI, the wafer industry is still soft. GlobalWafers' September 2026 revenue was NT$5.129bn, -13.1% YoY (+7.7% MoM), and January-September revenue was -4.4% YoY.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no direct history of a peer's monthly revenue moving 4063 at its print.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. It is a public monthly series from 10/08, and TWD translation muddies it. Shin-Etsu's Q1 text credits pricing ('価格修正') and AI volume for its wafer gains, so the peer read-through is weak. It is filed as a small negative proxy.
findings.independence: This shares the wafer-demand question with finding 2 but comes from a different company and series, and it points the other way. SUMCO's Q3 sales guide of +4% QoQ (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260806/140120260805509524.pdf) sits between the two.

findings.finding: This name sells its prints, and leveraged longs are crowded. Six of the last eight baseline reactions were negative (-9.45, -3.67, -11.16, -8.3 among them), and the margin ratio is 18.41x, so a hold that disappoints has margin sellers available.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly in the baseline lean already (margin_overhang -0.63). The incremental content is that the two Q2 holds in the record were both sold. It is kept small because a stock 24% off its July level with no disclosed shorts is also a 悪材料出尽くし candidate.
findings.independence: Reaction history comes from the sealed baseline; the margin ratio comes from kabutan. Both are about the stock, not the company.

rejected_candidates.detail: No document points to a further 売出 at this print; this is a historical event with no current filing behind it, so it was not filed as a finding. It informs abs_move_pct only.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the mild negative lean (priced_lean -0.68 from margin overhang) and adds little beyond it. The strongest positive the release could carry is an upward revision toward the 732bn consensus, or a surprise return item. I looked for both: there is no revision record at Q2 since 2022, buybacks come in April, and the dividend was already raised on 9/15. A 悪材料出尽くし rally after a 24% drawdown is the other real upside path.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series): the PVC, GlobalWafers and positioning negatives rest on series the market already has, so p_up moved 44 -> 46. The findings were already sized as proxies and were not shrunk again.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): 4 of 5 findings are negative. I wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension and had searched for it (revision record, buyback record, dividend), so this rule moved nothing further.
Finding sizes and print_vs_bar are unchanged; impact_sum stays -1.4 and expected_move goes from -0.54 to -0.36.
